alias_and_split_preflight.reason_not_executed: sample aliases, overlap, endpoint roles, and payload manifest are not frozen

authoritative_source_facts.audited_fact: The X-GAP project page documents a 49-group sample selected with R500 below 15 arcmin, redshift below 0.05, and more than eight optical members, spanning 1e13 < M500 < 1e14 solar masses; it reports that 38 groups had not previously been observed by modern X-ray satellites.
authoritative_source_facts.evidence_locator: official project page final-sample criteria and attachment table

authoritative_source_facts.audited_fact: The legacy project page names the FITS attachment, but the attachment URL currently redirects to the generic University of Geneva astronomy home page; no file bytes or rows were downloaded.
authoritative_source_facts.evidence_locator: official attachment URL and observed redirect destination

authoritative_source_facts.audited_fact: The project reports deprojected density, temperature, entropy, and pressure for four archival demonstration systems and states an intention to provide similar high-level products for the full sample; an intention is not a released 49-object file packet.
authoritative_source_facts.evidence_locator: official project observational-strategy text and high-level-product commitment

authoritative_source_facts.audited_fact: The 2024 primary paper describes a 49-object X-GAP program selected with z < 0.06 and reports an actual range 0.025 < z < 0.06, differing from the legacy project page's z < 0.05 statement. It says X-GAP data will be publicly released on the project website; the article license does not establish reuse terms for each future FITS, calibration, covariance, or stellar-baryon product.
authoritative_source_facts.evidence_locator: primary article sample-selection, reported sample range, data-release, and license statements

authoritative_source_facts.audited_fact: The current paper documents an analysis sample of 44 X-GAP groups in the 1e13-1e14 solar-mass range using the directly measured X-ray luminosity-temperature relation. It does not establish a machine-readable release of direct radial density, pressure, temperature, and stellar-baryon endpoints with their joint covariance.
authoritative_source_facts.evidence_locator: arXiv abstract, journal reference, DOI, and version history

authoritative_source_facts.audited_fact: The current forward-model analysis publishes integrated X-GAP observables and accounts for covariance among its population summaries. That population-level covariance is not a released per-object radial likelihood covariance, and the paper does not establish a complete direct density-pressure-temperature-stellar profile packet.
authoritative_source_facts.evidence_locator: arXiv abstract, journal reference, DOI, version history, section headings, and disclosed web-find excerpt incident

authoritative_source_facts.audited_fact: The XSA exposes observation data, ODFs, pipeline products, catalogs, and bibliographic links; archive availability does not identify the X-GAP observation set or supply the program's deprojection, stellar-baryon, and joint-covariance products.
authoritative_source_facts.evidence_locator: ESA XMM-Newton Science Archive documentation and access landing page
authoritative_source_facts.observed_release: XSA documentation and access page current in 2026 audit

authoritative_source_facts.audited_fact: ESA publishes calibration status, Current Calibration File guidance, and release notes; a future packet must freeze the exact SAS, CCF, response, background, PSF, and observation-specific calibration lineage.
authoritative_source_facts.evidence_locator: ESA XMM-Newton calibration documentation landing page and listed status revision
authoritative_source_facts.observed_release: EPIC calibration status 3.14 (February 2025) listed by ESA

authoritative_source_facts.audited_fact: Sun et al. analyze 43 Chandra groups with kT500 0.7-2.7 keV or M500 1e13-1e14 h^-1 solar masses; all reach beyond r2500, while 23 reach or are extrapolated to r500. The paper is not a verified object-level density, temperature, pressure, stellar-baryon, and covariance release.
authoritative_source_facts.evidence_locator: arXiv abstract, journal reference, and DOI metadata

authoritative_source_facts.audited_fact: eROSITA-DE DR1 publicly provides eRASS1 calibrated event lists, images, exposure and background maps, sensitivity maps, catalogs, selected bright-source products, eSASS4DR1, CALDB, and known-issue documentation for the western hemisphere.
authoritative_source_facts.evidence_locator: official eROSITA DR1 release landing page and release notices
authoritative_source_facts.observed_release: DR1 public 2024-01-31; main catalog v1.2 announced 2026-01-12

authoritative_source_facts.audited_fact: The official catalog page exposes a public object inventory and data model, but not the 1178-object eRASS:4 thermodynamic subset as a direct per-group endpoint packet.
authoritative_source_facts.evidence_locator: official eROSITA DR1 catalog release page and catalog metadata

authoritative_source_facts.audited_fact: The analysis starts from 1178 groups spanning 2.1e12-1e14 solar masses, bins them into 271 subsamples, and estimates stacked density, temperature, and entropy at characteristic radii using deeper eRASS:4 data and count-rate/scaling-relation mass estimates; these are not target-blind direct per-group endpoints.
authoritative_source_facts.evidence_locator: primary article abstract, methods metadata, journal reference, and DOI

limitations: This package records official metadata observed by 2026-08-29; it does not cache or redistribute source payloads.

One public appendix measurement row was rendered incidentally by an interactive web-find excerpt; it was not downloaded, persisted, used for readiness, or scored, so interactive zero-row purity is false while receipt-builder counts remain zero.
The legacy project page states z < 0.05, while the 2024 primary states z < 0.06 and reports 0.025 < z < 0.06; no eligibility rule is chosen until a canonical manifest reconciles the discrepancy.
The legacy X-GAP master filename and reported size are documented, but current bytes and a file hash are unavailable because the attachment redirects.
The receipt builder opened no aliases, thermodynamic rows, stellar-baryon rows, inferred-mass rows, lensing rows, or candidate scores.
A frozen split algorithm is not a frozen split assignment until canonical aliases and overlap exclusions are sealed.
Public raw observations and article-level licenses do not establish a complete licensed derived-product and covariance packet.

mass_scope.rule: A source may document membership in the approximate group-scale interval, but source-inferred hydrostatic, lensing, dynamical, richness, luminosity-scaling, or count-rate-scaling mass may not be loaded as a response or candidate input.

next_action: Obtain an official retrievable X-GAP alias manifest or replacement receipt, freeze its hash and per-file terms, reconcile X-COP/cross-lane aliases without response values, and require a complete density-pressure-temperature-stellar packet with covariance and calibration roles before executing the frozen whole-group split or requesting payload authorization.

audit_details.alias_and_overlap_blocker: The 49 master rows were not opened, the legacy FITS attachment currently redirects, the legacy/primary redshift discrepancy is unresolved, canonical aliases are not frozen, and X-COP overlap cannot be evaluated without that target-blind alias inventory.
audit_details.calibration_blocker: Mission calibration exists, but exact observation IDs, SAS/CCF revisions, filters, flare filtering, backgrounds, ARF/RMF, PSF mixing, and deprojection provenance are not frozen per group.
audit_details.covariance_blocker: Population-summary covariance in the current forward-model analysis does not substitute for a complete per-object within-radius, cross-radius, cross-endpoint, shared-background, PSF/response, deprojection, and stellar-population covariance packet; no such packet was verified.
audit_details.endpoint_blocker: Current papers provide integrated observables for 44 usable systems, but no current official full-sample file bundle was verified for direct radial density, pressure, spectroscopic temperature, and BGG+satellite+diffuse stellar baryon endpoints.
audit_details.licensing_blocker: The article is CC BY and XSA observations are public, but per-file reuse terms are not bound for the legacy master FITS or any future derived thermodynamic, covariance, and stellar-baryon products.
observed_availability: The official project page documents the exact 49-object mass-matched parent sample and a named v1.1 FITS master catalog.

audit_details.calibration_blocker: DR1 calibration products cannot by themselves reproduce the deeper eRASS:4 stacked analysis, and exact stack-specific background, response, PSF, and selection covariance is not frozen.
